prompt:
Use case: productivity-visual
Asset type: 16:9 pitch-deck cover visual for the Chinese community service project 搭把手
Primary request: Create a sophisticated contemporary Beijing residential-community scene that feels like a living community map. Include apartment buildings, a community service center, shared activity room, parcel station, clinic, garden and sports area connected by subtle jade-green paths. Residents of different ages naturally use the community: a young resident collecting a parcel, neighbors sharing a household tool, a parent walking with a child, and an older resident speaking with a community worker.
Style: high-end editorial illustration blended with realistic architectural visualization; warm, credible, restrained, human, modern Chinese urban community.
Composition: 16:9 landscape. Main scene on the right 58 percent. Leave the left 38 percent calm, bright and uncluttered for editable PowerPoint title text.
Color palette: warm off-white #F8F7F0, jade green #2F6B5F, coral accents #F06A4B, subtle amber #E9A23B, deep ink #17313B.
Constraints: no text, no Chinese characters, no numbers, no logos, no UI, no QR code, no watermark. Avoid government propaganda, luxury-real-estate advertising, neon technology effects, purple gradients and generic corporate stock imagery.

Use case: photorealistic-natural
Asset type: 16:9 pitch-deck visual supporting full-age neighborhood mutual-aid needs
Primary request: Create one coherent editorial scene in a real contemporary Chinese residential community showing four naturally connected moments: a young new resident borrowing a small household tool from a neighbor; two families exchanging children's books and toys; a middle-aged adult helping an older parent find community medical-service information; and a younger neighbor patiently teaching an older resident a smartphone function.
Style: candid editorial lifestyle photography, natural Chinese residents, ordinary clothing, realistic architecture, respectful and unstaged.
Composition: 16:9 wide scene, four interactions connected through one shared courtyard rather than a four-panel collage. Leave clean negative space along the top and left for editable slide labels.
Lighting and mood: soft natural daylight, warm, trustworthy, everyday, optimistic but not sentimental.
Color palette: warm off-white, jade green, muted coral and subtle amber accents.
Constraints: no text, no labels, no numbers, no logos, no watermark, no stereotypical helpless older adults, no staged handshakes, no corporate stock-photo look.

Use case: photorealistic-natural
Asset type: 16:9 pitch-deck visual showing the operational burden of a Chinese community service office
Primary request: Create a credible community-service office in Beijing. A community worker is verifying public-service information arriving from fragmented channels: government websites, official-account posts, printed notices, activity forms and volunteer-service listings. A second worker is answering a resident call while organizing event information. Screens and documents may contain abstract unreadable marks only, never legible text.
Style: realistic editorial workplace photography, professional, restrained, locally grounded.
Composition: place workers and fragmented sources on the right 60 percent. Leave the left 35 percent clean for editable data cards. Show repeated checking and cross-referencing without exaggerated chaos.
Color palette: warm neutral office, jade-green accents, soft amber paper details, deep ink gray.
Constraints: no readable text, no Chinese characters, no numbers, no logos, no government seals, no personal data, no watermark, no comedic stress scene.

Use case: infographic-diagram
Asset type: editable-slide visual foundation for a community-service ecosystem
Primary request: Create a refined minimal top-down three-dimensional illustration of a contemporary Chinese residential community. Include residential buildings, community service center, shared kitchen, activity room, small clinic, parcel station, community garden, sports area, reading room and walking paths. Connect locations with elegant subtle jade-green paths and a few coral activity markers.
Style: sophisticated editorial map illustration, warm, human, clean, professional, visually calm. Not a navigation screenshot and not a game map.
Composition: 16:9 landscape. Map occupies the center and right. Leave clean space around important nodes so editable labels can be added later in Canva or PowerPoint.
Color palette: #F8F7F0 canvas, #2F6B5F trust paths, #F06A4B action markers, #E9A23B subtle highlights, #17313B structures.
Constraints: no text, no labels, no numbers, no legends, no logos, no watermark, no futuristic smart-city holograms, no purple-blue gradients.

Use case: photorealistic-natural
Asset type: 16:9 pitch-deck visual for trustworthy low-risk neighborhood mutual aid
Primary request: Create a candid contemporary Chinese residential-community scene with several low-risk mutual-aid interactions: one neighbor handing over a collected parcel; another lending a small household tool; two residents exchanging unused household items; and a young resident explaining a smartphone function to an older neighbor. The community feels safe, ordinary and lived-in. Interactions are friendly but not overly intimate.
Style: premium editorial photography with realistic Chinese residents and architecture, natural textures and believable body language.
Composition: 16:9 wide composition with visual depth and natural movement. Leave the upper-left area clean for editable PowerPoint title and data.
Mood: warm, trustworthy, everyday, energetic but not sentimental.
Constraints: no text, no logos, no watermark, no medical emergency, no money lending, no entry into private homes, no staged corporate handshake, no luxury community advertising.

Use case: photorealistic-natural
Asset type: 16:9 closing-slide background for the Chinese community service project 搭把手
Primary request: Create a quiet early-evening scene in a contemporary Beijing residential community. Warm lights begin to turn on. Residents of different ages return home, briefly greet one another, use shared spaces and help with small everyday tasks. The image communicates connection, safety, belonging and a functioning neighborhood without becoming sentimental.
Style: cinematic editorial lifestyle photography, realistic and restrained.
Composition: 16:9. Main visual activity on the right 58 percent. Leave the left 38 percent calm and uncluttered for editable project name and closing message.
Lighting: natural blue-hour and warm window light, subtle jade and coral accents.
Constraints: no text, no logos, no signs, no watermark, no dramatic fantasy sunset, no luxury real-estate advertising, no staged group portrait.
